(section) Amended Sec. 241
(quote) Only an inhabitant of this state, except idiots and insane persons, who is a citizen of the United States of America, eighteen (18) years old and upward,
(section) Ballot explanation
(quote) This proposed constitutional amendment aligns the state constitution with federal court rulings and solidifies that only citizens of the United States are allowed the opportunity to vote in Mississippi.
(other) Concurrent resolution proposing amendment of Section 241 of the Mississippi Constitution; election date and ballot explanation
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
